evidence.summary: The PAP Command College in Tianjin describes itself as the People’s Armed Police’s college for mid-level command cadres, training regiment-level commanders, political and staff officers and instructors and awarding master’s degrees in military command, political work, management and training; it traces its history to a 1951 cadre school of the Central Military Commission’s public security forces and says more than 65% of its graduates have commanded exercises, emergency response, counter-terrorism or disaster-relief operations. NDU’s study of the PAP lists it among the force’s academies.

The college gives its grade as corps leader, and China’s graduate admissions site names the PLA as its supervising department; NDU notes that the PAP has answered to the Central Military Commission alone since the 2017–2018 reforms.
